defect: CTX%/token-total display inflation in the swarm/waits observability views (secondary, distinct from the original CODING_FAILED root cause)
root_cause: `state.cumulativeUsage.promptTokens += promptTokens` (line 265, pre-fix) treated `promptTokens` from each AI SDK finish-step event as a per-step DELTA and summed it across every step. In real chat-completion API semantics, `promptTokens` at each step IS the whole conversation-so-far sent to the model that turn (it already grows monotonically as the conversation lengthens) -- it is not incremental. Summing an already-cumulative quantity across N steps produces roughly O(N^2) growth relative to the real context size, which is exactly the runaway CTX% (99% -> 117% -> 162% -> 1088%, Sigma tokens 2206.6k) observed live on the awesome-researcher re-drive.
why_the_abort_guard_was_unaffected: session/runner.ts's context-window abort guard (lines 401-403, 499-506) reads `event.usage.promptTokens` from the per-step `step-finish` StreamEvent, which is `stepUsage` in stream-handler.ts (the correct, non-accumulated per-step value) -- NOT `state.cumulativeUsage`. This is why real coding work (6+ commits) proceeded correctly even while the UI displayed an absurd CTX% -- the actual session-level safety guard was reading the right number the whole time; only the swarm/waits DISPLAY was wrong.
fix_applied: Changed `state.cumulativeUsage.promptTokens` and `.cacheReadTokens`/`.cacheCreationTokens` from `+=` accumulation to plain assignment (latest value wins), since these ARE already-cumulative-per-session quantities from the SDK's own usage object. `completionTokens` correctly remains `+=` accumulated (it genuinely is a per-step delta -- each step generates new completion tokens on top of prior ones). `totalTokens` is now derived as `promptTokens + completionTokens` post-fix instead of also being independently summed.
